## Names

<a id="hitzone_up_fwd"></a>
### [`hitzone_up_fwd`](../../../../src/fighter/hit_zone_tables.asm#L6) `$7200-$723A`

*data*

The 1298 bytes are the same as in version I. The tables cover only the fighter frames $00-$3a.

- **Entry of:** [`move_hit_zone_facing`](../../tables.md#move_hit_zone_facing)

<a id="hitzone_down_fwd_crouch"></a>
### [`hitzone_down_fwd_crouch`](../../../../src/fighter/hit_zone_tables.asm#L16) `$723B-$7275`

*data*

Hit zones of move $07 (down-forward from the crouch, no fire) against an opponent that faces the attacker. One byte per target frame $00-$3a. $80 means no hit. Else $2bc6 adds $80 and compares it with the distance and the reach tables $11bd/$11d6.

- **Entry of:** [`move_hit_zone_facing`](../../tables.md#move_hit_zone_facing)

*data*

- **Entry of:** [`move_hit_zone_facing`](../../tables.md#move_hit_zone_facing)
